content: भक्तिः {%f.%} [भज्-क्तिन्] .²1 Separation, partition, division. .²2 A division, portion, share. .²3 .³({%a%}) Devotion, attachment, loyalty, faithfulness; तद्भक्तिसंक्षिप्तबृहत्प्रमाणमारुह्य कैलासमिव प्रतस्थे <ls>Ku. 7. 37</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 63</ls>; <ls>Mu. 1. 15</ls>. .³({%b%}) Faith, belief, pious faith. .²4 Reverence, service, worship, homage. .²5 Texture, arrangement; भवति विरलभक्तिर्म्लानपुष्पोपहारः <ls>R. 5. 74</ls>; मणिमरीचिरचितेन्द्रचापभक्तयः विद्याधरपतयः <ls>Nāg. 5</ls>. .²6 Decoration, ornament, embellishment; सुकृतेहामृगाकीर्णं सूत्कीर्णं भक्तिभिस्तथा <ls>Rām. 2. 15. 35</ls>; आबद्धमुक्ताफलभक्तिचित्रे <ls>Ku. 7. 10</ls>, <ls n="Ku. 7.">94</ls>; <ls>R. 13. 55</ls>, <ls n="R. 13.">75</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 30</ls>. अधिरुह्य स वज्रभक्तिचित्रम् (आसनम्) <ls>Bu. Ch. 5. 44</ls>. .²7 An attribute. .²8 The being part of, belonging to. .²9 A figurative sense, secondary sense; भक्त्या निष्कयवादः स्यात् <ls>MS. 4. 4. 28</ls> (भक्त्या here seems to have been used as an indeclinable); <ab>cf.</ab> also <ls>MS. 8. 3. 22</ls>. .²10 Predisposition (of body to any disease).
